# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

 

 

## Where we’re making news

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here are some of the latest stories.

# Texture that transforms every bite

See how our collaborative approach turns concepts into next-level sensory experiences

[Explore texture innovations][1]

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help
propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

### Measurably advance your ESG outcomes

**How Ingredion can help:**
* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us
* Help execute on your ESG goals, measure progress and report meaningful advancements to your
  stakeholders
* Sustainably deliver products with the taste, texture and benefits consumers prefer

[Learn more][4]

[Picture 735315543]

## Our expertise

Ingredion is much more than a supplier. A partnership with us will enable you to increase speed to
market with high-quality, value-added products that consumers want.

[none, Picture]

### Nutrition, health and wellness

Our portfolio of science-backed solutions for enhancing nutrition, delivering health benefits and
enabling wellness lifestyle choices is designed to help brands and manufacturers deliver winning
consumer products.

[Learn more][5]

[Glasses of Bubble Tea]

### Sugar reduction

With our unmatched technical expertise, we enable customers to make the most of our robust portfolio
and deliver best-in-class reduced-sugar formulations that win in the market.

[Learn more][6]

[Clean and simple condiments with garnishes]

### Clean and simple ingredients

We combine pioneering solutions and proprietary market insights with formulation
expertise—delivering the cleaner ingredients and simpler labels that consumers understand and
prefer.

[Learn more][7]

[Sliced, stacked, chocolate covered protein bars]

### Plant-based proteins

We bring our extensive portfolio of sustainable plant-protein solutions and formulation expertise to
help customers bring products with consumer-preferred taste, texture and nutrition to market.

[Learn more][8]

[Overhead shot of various pastries]

### Flavorings with Modifying Properties

Ingredion’s consultative taste solution helps food and beverage manufacturers enhance and balance
flavors while solving better-for-you product challenges.

[Learn more][9]

[Texturants]

### Texturants and texture solutions

We combine our 100+ years of texturant know-how with our passion for food science and broadest
portfolio of texturizing solutions to help manufacturers achieve their formulation needs.

[Learn more][10]

[Supermarket aisle view from behind a red-handled shopping cart, surrounded by shelves stocked with
colorful grocery products. Clean, shiny floor and bright lighting, with a shopper visible in the
distance]

### Less mystery, more meaning: Clean labels win consumer preference

Discover how grocery shopping decisions are evolving. Ingredion’s latest research highlights key
trends in health, clean label claims and generational preferences shaping the future of food and
beverage

[View insights][11]

### Strengthen your nutrition, health and wellness strategy

It all starts with the right ingredients. Download our selection guide to see how we can help you
create food and beverages with the right combination of features and benefits to delight today's
consumers.

[Download guide][12]

[Picture 698766832, Picture]

Explore our comprehensive portfolio of products, order samples and download technical documentation
directly.

[Explore ingredients][13]

The “Rite” sweetener **MaltRite^{TM}, OatRite^{TM}, TapRite^{TM} and RiceRite^{TM}** are all
natural, nutritive, non-gmo-verifed, sweeteners. A label-friendly, cost-effective alternative to
highly refined sugars. The smarter way to sweeten. Healthy from the ground up Naturally high in
protein, amino acids, minerals, soluble fiber, and antioxidants, MaltRite™ and OatRite™ are made
from whole sprouted grains, and have characteristic flavor and aroma from mild to robust. Domestic
manufacturing and customer service The highly skilled food technologists in our new state-of-the art
U.S. manufacturing facility and innovation lab are dedicated to helping customers create the best
natural sweetener solution for their specific needs. Sweeteners with substance since 1957 In
addition to our **“Rite”** sweeteners, we also offer a broad spectrum of ingredients including sugar
cane molasses, invert syrups, agave, honey, corn sweeteners, and diastatic flours. Ideal for baked
goods, beverages, snack foods, cereals, confections, pet food, and much more. Appreciate the
difference A family-owned business that treats businesses like family.
Customer centric. Quality driven.
Nutritionally focused.

Malt Products is a family business that manufactures and distributes natural, nutritious sweeteners.
We have been in business since the 1950s, when we started processing barley from local farmers into
malt extract to supply local bagel shops and mom-and-pop bakeries. In the decades since then, we
have grown into an international company offering a full line of natural, nutritious grain extracts
and sweeteners.

We source our extracts from whole grains, such as malted barley, oats, and rice, and we offer a full
range of other sweeteners, such as molasses, tapioca syrup, invert syrups, agave nectar, and honey.
Our ingredients are available with non-GMO and organic certification. Fundamental to our success is
our personal touch—customer service built on sustained relationships, impeccable quality, and
limitless customization.


MaltRite™^{TM} extracts are made from whole grain malted barley, the original sprouted grain, and
have a characteristic malty flavor and aroma from mild to robust.

[Learn More][29]

OatRite^{TM} extracts are made from whole grain sprouted oats and have a mild sweetness and pleasant
oat taste and aroma.

[Learn More][30]

TapRite^{TM} is a clean, neutral flavored syrup made from tapioca starch, which comes from the
cassava root.

[Learn More][31]

RiceRite^{TM} is an all-natural sweetener, made from brown rice, that adds sweetness with little or
no flavor or color.

[Learn More][32]

## Sugar Cane Molasses

Sugar Cane Molasses is a natural and nutritious sweetener with a distinct and rich flavor, extracted
from sugar cane during the production of refined sugar.

[Learn More][33]

## Invert Syrups

Nuvert^{TM} Syrup is derived from sugar cane. The sucrose is inverted creating a sweeter syrup less
prone to crystallization.

[Learn More][34]

## Agave Syrups

Organic agave syrup is a versatile ingredients used to sweeten a wide variety of food products.

[Learn More][35]

## Corn Sweeteners

We offer a complete line of corn based sweeteners; glucose syrup 30, 42 and 60DE, high fructose 42
and 55, dextrose, and maltodextrins.

[Learn More][36]

## Diastatic Flours

Our top rated Baker’s helper is a dry mix of diastatic malted barley flour, wheat flour and
dextrose. The active enzymes are a natural dough conditioner.

[Learn More][37]

## Honey

Bakers Honey provides quality and value to many food products. Its subtle touch enriches the flavors
of a wide variety of food products.

[Learn More][38]

### Gallery

Our commitment to industry-leading innovation and the security and reliability of domestic
production is showcased by our state-of-the-art brewhouse and drying plant in our Dayton, Ohio
manufacturing facility.

OatRite^{TM} extracts are made from whole grain sprouted oats and have a mild sweetness and pleasant
oat taste and aroma.

[Learn More][30]

TapRite^{TM} is a clean, neutral flavored syrup made from tapioca starch, which comes from the
cassava root.

[Learn More][31]

RiceRite^{TM} is an all-natural sweetener, made from brown rice, that adds sweetness with little or
no flavor or color.

[Learn More][32]

## Sugar Cane Molasses

Sugar Cane Molasses is a natural and nutritious sweetener with a distinct and rich flavor, extracted
from sugar cane during the production of refined sugar.

[Learn More][33]

## Invert Syrups

Nuvert^{TM} Syrup is derived from sugar cane. The sucrose is inverted creating a sweeter syrup less
prone to crystallization.

[Learn More][34]

## Agave Syrups

Organic agave syrup is a versatile ingredients used to sweeten a wide variety of food products.

[Learn More][35]

## Corn Sweeteners

We offer a complete line of corn based sweeteners; glucose syrup 30, 42 and 60DE, high fructose 42
and 55, dextrose, and maltodextrins.

[Learn More][36]

## Diastatic Flours

Our top rated Baker’s helper is a dry mix of diastatic malted barley flour, wheat flour and
dextrose. The active enzymes are a natural dough conditioner.

[Learn More][37]

## Honey

Bakers Honey provides quality and value to many food products. Its subtle touch enriches the flavors
of a wide variety of food products.

[Learn More][38]

Our commitment to industry-leading innovation and the security and reliability of domestic
production is showcased by our state-of-the-art brewhouse and drying plant in our Dayton, Ohio
manufacturing facility.

# Sensient Technologies

Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors,
and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain
capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve
the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and personal care industries.

Manufacturer of Natural & Functional Food Ingredients and Additives

Aarkay Food Products Ltd is a leading manufacturer of Natural Food Ingredients and Additives that
give taste, color, texture and nutrition to a wide variety of food & beverage products. We have a
diverse yet harmonious product portfolio which consists of Spray Dried Ingredients like Tomato
Powder, Fruit & Vegetable Powder, Cheese Powders, Non-Dairy Creamers and Fat Powders, Dairy
Ingredients, Enzyme Modified Ingredients, Natural Food Colors and a multitude of Specialty
Ingredients.

We are continuously working and remain committed in Harnessing Nature's Potential & serving our
customers through high quality products, innovative technologies and a vision to build a brighter
future with natural ingredients

## What We Do

We are importers and distributors of specialty food ingredients serving the industrial food
manufacturers and snack re-packers in North America.

From the field to your plant floor, we are fully engaged in every step of the process, so you can
focus on yours.

## Our Core Values

**INTEGRITY**

A promise is a promise. We uphold our commitments to each other, suppliers and customers alike.

**QUALITY**

We recognize that what we do matters and has an impact. Therefore, we do our utmost to provide our
customers with the ingredients that we trust to feed our own families.

**RELATIONSHIPS**

We believe in cultivating long-term relationships and work hard every day to preserve them.

**CUSTOMER FOCUSED**

We constantly strive to provide exceptional, no-hassle service.

**OUR PROMISE**

All Gold consistently and reliably delivers safe food while providing you, our customers, with the
market intelligence to make informed decisions.

**WE’RE SERIOUS ABOUT**

## Food Safety

Our dedicated quality assurance team manages and maintains a global Food Safety Program that governs
our operations, as well as those of our suppliers and 3PL warehouses.

**OUR CERTIFICATIONS**

All Gold is proud to be a SQF-certified facility.

Various certifications may apply to All Gold Imports, suppliers and 3PLs.

**OUR ROOTS RUN DEEP**

## Bringing You Quality Food Since 1899

We began as produce merchants in South Africa in 1899. Five generations later and after 30+ years of
operations in Canada, we are one of the nation’s premiere importers of specialty commodities for
industrial food manufacturers.

### [Negociants New Zealand][18]

brands from Australia and around the world.

[Get in touch][19]

industry of Australia with a premium portfolio of family owned national and international fine wines

[Get in touch][25]

across the US. Antipodes is imported by Finesaler on the East Coast.

[Get in touch][28]

[United States - Texas, Florida][29]

[Get in touch][31]

[Middle East][32]

hotel and dining industries across the Middle East.

[Get in touch][34]

[China][35]

### [Summergate Fine Wines & Spirits][36]

proud to partner with high quality brands and distributes some of the most internationally renowned
brands in the market.

[Get in touch][37]

[Hong Kong][38]

### [Continental Wines][39]

### [The First Pour Singapore][42]

and character behind the brand. They offer a wide range of spirits and drinks for your pleasure and
enjoyment.

[Get in touch][43]

[Japan][44]

### [Japan Salt][45]

Japan Salt carries over 1,000 types of salt, as well as ingredients from Japan and abroad. They

approximately 3,000 other products and ingredients.

[Get in touch][46]

[Korea][47]

### [The Vin CSR][48]

[Get in touch][49]

[Taiwan][50]

### [Water Selection][51]

Water Selection, founded in 2018, is the first premium water distribution online platform in Taiwan.

world’s natural water source to their consumers.

[Get in touch][52]

[Get in touch][55]

## A dynamic Indonesian company engaged in general trading and halal food manufacturing

With an annual turnover of approximately USD 10 million, the company plays an active role in

About Us

## PT Ageng Arto Moro (PT AAM) operates through three main divisions

General Trading Division Food Manufacturing Division Licensing & Permits Division

Engaged in the import and distribution of premium food ingredients, spices, and specialty food
products sourced from trusted global suppliers. PT AAM also serves as an authorized agent for
several food manufacturing companies from China, representing their products and facilitating market
access in Indonesia.

Our current annual import volume **has reached USD 6 million**, and we continue to expand our
sourcing network across Asia to introduce new halal-certified products featuring advanced food
technology.

Produces halal-certified food products that combine Indonesian taste preferences with international
quality standards. We collaborate with foreign brands through joint-production partnerships, with a
particular focus on serving the Indonesian market effectively.
* Provides regulatory and compliance solutions to help companies meet Indonesia’s licensing
  requirements efficiently.
* Our expertise includes Halal Certification, BPOM registration, environmental permits, and other
  government approvals.
* PT AAM also assists both domestic producers and foreign certification bodies in securing Mutual
  Recognition Agreements (MRA) with BPJPH, ensuring international recognition of halal standards.

## Vision

To be a leading halal food manufacturer and trading company in Indonesia, recognized for quality,
reliability, and international standards.

## Mission
* To provide safe, nutritious, and halal food products for both local and export markets.
* To build long-term partnerships with suppliers and customers based on trust and mutual growth.
* To innovate continuously in product development and service excellence.
* To contribute to Indonesia’s role in the global halal food supply chain.

LICENSING & PERMITS

At PT AAM, we provide specialized regulatory and compliance services designed to help companies
navigate Indonesia’s licensing landscape with confidence and clarity.

Our expertise covers a wide range of permits — from general business licenses to specialized
sectoral approvals — with a strong focus on Halal Certification and international halal recognition
under the authority of BPJPH (Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Produk Halal).

## Halal Certification & Mutual Recognition Services

Indonesia is home to one of the world’s largest halal consumer markets. Compliance with national
halal standards is not only a legal requirement but also a strategic advantage for product
acceptance, market access, and brand credibility.

PT AAM assists both domestic producers and foreign certification bodies or exporters in obtaining
and maintaining compliance with BPJPH regulations. Our services include:

End-to-end assistance in halal certification

from documentation, audit preparation, and laboratory-testing coordination to post-certification
follow-up.

Advisory on BPJPH regulations and the Halal Assurance System (SJPH)

Ensuring your internal processes meet Indonesian halal standards.

Facilitation of Mutual Recognition Agreements (MRA) between foreign halal certifying bodies and
BPJPH

Enabling international recognition and smoother export–import of halal products.

Representation and liaison

With BPJPH, MUI, and other relevant authorities to expedite reviews, verifications, and formal
approvals.

Consultation for product registration with BPOM and halal–non-halal labeling integration

Ensuring regulatory harmony for both domestic and export markets.

## Other Licensing & Permit Services

Beyond halal-related services, we also provide comprehensive support for other essential licenses,
including:

PRODUCTS

## Imports and Partnerships

Our import philosophy is built on international partnerships that reflect our dedication to sourcing
only the best food and ingredients. We currently import:
* **Spices from several Asian countries**
* **Specialty food products from Thailand and China**

These imports are integrated into our product lines and distributed through our nationwide marketing
channels, ensuring consistent quality and halal assurance across all products.

dedication to quality, integrity, and professionalism.

pharma, biotech and self-care companies to accelerate the development, manufacturing and delivery of

transform bold ideas into life-changing therapies and self-care solutions.

## About Chemvera

We are a global specialty chemicals distributor importing from across the world and cater to
different markets in India as well as overseas. 

Chemvera has two divisions: 

Polymer Division and Food & Nutraceuticals Division


We started polymer division in 2015 with main focus on PVC additives for various applications like
pipes, cables, flex banners, window profiles, artificial leather cloth, sheeting, shrink film, and
more. 

 

In 2019, we ventured into the space of food and nutraceutical ingredients. We offer a comprehensive
portfolio of high-performance ingredients from the world’s leading manufacturers. Along with our
principals, we provide formulation expertise to succeed across a broad range of food and
nutraceutical applications – bakery, beverages, dairy, proteins, snacks, and more.

Food and Nutraceutical Division

The ingredients are imported directly from first-class suppliers from Europe, United States of
America, South America and Asia.  In many cases we are the exclusive representative of international
producers and multinationals in different regions in India.

合成生物学在食品领域的应用正迅速崛起，特别体现在新食品原料和食品添加剂的开发制造方面。通过设计改造微

原国家食品药品监督管理总局（CFDA）和国家市场监督管理总局（SAMR）的监管，其管理方式在近三十年间不断优
化，对保健食品的审评要求也在不断调整和完善。

[食品添加剂新品种中国市场准入指南][34]
随着食品工业的迅速发展和健康意识的增强，人们对食物品质的要求和对食品添加剂的认知不断提高。因而，越来
越多的食品添加剂新品种得以开发应用，对食品添加剂新品种的研究已成为一种世界趋势。
为了规范食品添加剂新品种的使用，保障食品安全，食品添加剂新品种需经过安全性评估，审批通过后方能进入市
场销售。我国在1983年首次提出食品添加剂新品种的管理要求，并于1993年发布首个配套法规。经过30多年的发展
，法规体系日益完善，目前已有众多食品添加剂新品种通过审批。

national markets, we simplify your search and accelerate your distribution network growth.

high-potential distributors that match your business goals.

# Rooted in Legacy. Driven by Quality.

[View Products ][7]

We are Emmelco Exports India Pvt. Ltd., the global export arm of the ML Group — carrying nearly a
century of trading trust into fresh markets.

## BRAND STRENGTH

Emmelco At A Glance

Discover the strengths that make Emmelco a trusted global partner in quality Indian exports

01

### 100 Years of Heritage

With nearly a century of experience, Emmelco carries forward the legacy of the ML Group, founded in
1925. Our journey from a local trading house in Changanacherry to a global export enterprise
reflects decades of trust, ethics, and entrepreneurial excellence, making us a reliable partner for
businesses worldwide.

02

### Global Reach

From India to every corner of the globe, Emmelco bridges the gap between premium Indian ingredients
and international markets. Our robust logistics, compliance expertise, and supply chain management
ensure that our products reach clients efficiently, safely, and on schedule, no matter where they
are.

03

### Trusted By Industries

We are a preferred partner for confectionery, bakery, beverage, and nutraceutical brands around the
world. Our focus on consistency, purity, and quality has earned the trust of businesses who rely on
us for high-quality ingredients that meet their exacting production and taste standards.

04

### Certified & Compliant

Every product we export is sourced from verified Indian manufacturers and complies with
international quality and safety standards. From rigorous quality checks to proper documentation and
certifications, Emmelco ensures that every consignment reflects our commitment to excellence and
regulatory compliance.

[coffee-cafe-fabric.jpg]

## ABOUT US

From rice & tapioca trade in 1925 to today’s global sourcing powerhouse — Emmelco continues the
vision of founder M.L. Pappachan.

[Our Story ][8]

## WHY EMMELCO?

Integrity Built Over Generations

At Emmelco, we do more than export products — we deliver partnerships built on trust, performance,
and consistency.

01

### Integrity & Trust - A Legacy of Four Generations

Our name carries the weight of nearly 100 years of business ethics. Every transaction, from
requirement analysis to shipment, reflects the honesty and reliability that define the ML Group.

02

### Certified Quality — Meeting Global Standards

Each product is sourced from verified Indian manufacturers who follow international safety and
quality protocols. We ensure that every consignment matches the purity, consistency, and
specifications our clients demand.

03

### Reliable Supply & Global Logistics

We understand the importance of dependability in trade. With robust supply chains and strong
logistics partners, Emmelco guarantees timely delivery and consistent quality, shipment after
shipment

[ingredient-bags-full-flour.jpg]

## Our Solutions / Products

### Natural Sweeteners & Jaggery Products

Pure, chemical-free, and nutrient-rich — our natural jaggery powders and sweeteners bring
traditional Indian goodness to global health and food brands. Perfect for those seeking unrefined,
authentic sweetness with modern consistency.

### Starches, Derivatives & Edible Oils

From corn starch and dextrose to sunflower and coconut oils, we supply essential ingredients that
form the foundation of food, beverage, and manufacturing industries. Each product is tested and
traceable for quality assurance.

### Custom Sourcing Solutions

Every market has unique needs — and we cater to them all. Through our custom sourcing division, we
identify, verify, and deliver products from certified Indian producers, managing everything from
supplier selection to global shipping.

## Ready to get started?

Looking for a trusted export partner in India?

Let’s build something lasting — backed by heritage, quality, and reliability.

a long-term business relationship with our clients, providing top-notch product quality and offer
them the best deal that we could offer.

**Our Products**
**INSTANT COFFEE**
Our soluble coffee retains most of the aroma and flavours from freshly roasted coffee beans.

[][13]

Sugar is essentially crystallised sucrose that sweetens dishes and drinks. It also improves flavour,
texture and decoration.

sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?

Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]

agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Graveyard Keeper

[Graveyard Keeper][77] is the most inaccurate medieval cemetery management sim of the year. Build &
manage your own graveyard while finding shortcuts to cut costs, expand into entertainment with
witch-burning festivals, and scare nearby villagers into attending church. This is a game of
capitalism and doing whatever it takes to build a thriving business. **Graveyard Keeper** was
created by Lazy Bear Games and published by tinyBuild.

Welcome to the Official
[Graveyard Keeper Wiki]
The most comprehensive source of information about the game.
We are currently maintaining [4,597 pages (841 articles)][78], written by 42,194,818 users.

About Graveyard Keeper

[Graveyard Keeper][77] is the most inaccurate medieval cemetery management sim of the year. Build &
manage your own graveyard while finding shortcuts to cut costs, expand into entertainment with
witch-burning festivals, and scare nearby villagers into attending church. This is a game of
capitalism and doing whatever it takes to build a thriving business. **Graveyard Keeper** was
created by Lazy Bear Games and published by tinyBuild.

Welcome to the Official
[Graveyard Keeper Wiki]
The most comprehensive source of information about the game.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

# Innovative Food Ingredients

## Three Generations of Flavour

Specialists in the development and supply of high quality food ingredients to Butchers, Farm Shops
and Food Processors

#### HIGH QUALITY INGREDIENTS, INNOVATION & COLLABORATION

**At IFI, our mission is to passionately serve our customers with unparalleled dedication,
innovative solutions, and the highest quality food ingredients.**

A family business with three generations of flavour experience and knowhow, we’re a catalyst in
bringing the retail food and butchery sectors together to add value and enhance the quality of their
produce. Our aim is to help you craft delicious, easy to make and cost effective dishes that delight
every palate.

## Buy Food
## Ingredients

**Ever more discerning consumer tastes are driving up demand for distinct, international flavours.**

When our customers need new flavours to extend their ranges, we have a dedicated e-commerce platform
for a core range of stocked ingredients and recipe inspiration.

Additional benefits include fulfilment of Natasha’s Law labelling requirements and free next day
delivery for orders over £80.

[ View our range ][19]

## Bold Taste
## Awaits

**Taste Creation is designed to dovetail perfectly with the needs of food manufacturers, offering
them the consumer insights, creativity and technical knowledge to bring that extra bit of flavour to
their food produce.**

Here you will find everything you need to tap into our fully customised food product development
services and access the commodities you need to help manufacture your products.

As well as supply, distribution and resource support, we can also help with ample stock holding of
bespoke ingredients for a just in time service.

[ Food Ingredient Development ][20]

## Ingredient

**We’re supporting food businesses, butcher shop owners, craft butchers and their apprentices across
the UK with exclusive access to trade information, knowledge sharing of food and flavour trends,
education, industry insights and resources. **

The Butchers’ Collective is a free members portal which connects you up with a highly knowledgeable
community of experts offering industry insights, webinars and marketing tools.

[ Go to The Collective ][21]

### Customer-Centricity

We place our customers at the heart of everything we do, striving to exceed their expectations
through exceptional service and tailored, dynamic solutions.

### Innovation

We embrace creativity and forward-thinking to develop innovative ingredients that set new standards
in the food industry.

### Quality

We are committed to sourcing and delivering only the ﬁnest ingredients, ensuring superior quality
and consistency in every product.

### Integrity

We conduct our business with honesty, transparency, and respect, building trust with our customers,
partners, and employees.

### Collaboration

We believe in the power of teamwork and partnership, working closely with our customers to
understand their unique needs and achieve shared success.

## WIDE RANGE OF APPLICATIONS
* Beverages
* Dairy products
* Baking
* Cookies
* Jelly
* Candy
* Sausage
* ##### Beverages
  
  A wide range of ingredients are required in their formulation of beverages.Additives like sugar or
  sweeteners which are added in higher amounts whereas additives like preservatives are added in
  small quantity. Hence additives may be grouped as Major and Minor additives.
* ##### Dairy products
  
  Dairy system is a complex colloidal dispersion system, the dispersion medium is water, and the
  dispersions are lactose, inorganic salts, protein, fat, gas, etc. It is an unstable system. Dairy
  products are both highly nutritious and highly unstable substances that are prone to spoilage.
  emulsifier in dairy milk and preservatives used in milk are important for dairy processing.
  Nutritional fortification, stabilization of the milk system, and extension of shelf life. When
  adding natural vegetable fiber ingredients and transglutaminase for sale to milk with wheat,
  cereals, eggs and other substances, add emulsification stabilizers to delay the floating of milk
  fat and protein precipitation to achieve a balance of emulsion, so that the product does not
  stratify and change the structure, and extend the shelf life.
* ##### Baking
  
  Food attives is widely used in baking.They were added to flour products for a variety of purposes,
  including bleaching the flour, ageing, slowing the rate of staling, and improving the texture of
  the finished product,Kemfood shall provide the best sulotion for you.
* ##### Cookies
  
  The ingredients used in preparation of cookies affect size, color, and sensory qualities.
  Additional ingredients are also added for flavor and texture. There are two main types of cookies,
  soft and hard cookies. Soft cookies contain more liquids to produce the necessary structure i.e.,
  moistness and softness. THE MAIN INGREDIENTS present in nearly every type of cookie are wheat
  flour, sweeteners ,fat,sodium bicarbonate and ammonium bicarbonate.
* ##### Jelly
  
  The application of food ingredients especially food thickeners is a key technology in jelly
  production. Substances essential for fruit jelly making are fruit flavor, pectin, sugar, acid and
  water. A pectin gel or jelly forms when a suitable concentration of pectin, sugar, acid, and water
  is achieved.
* ##### Candy
  
  Food additives are substances added to food to preserve flavour or enhance its taste and
  appearance. There are many types of food additives in candy which serve different purposes such as
  emulsifiers, stabilizers, thickeners, anti­caking agents, preservatives, antioxidants, leavening
  agents, acidulants, and natural or artificial colours and flavours.
  A main component of candies is food colouring. There are two types of food colourings – natural
  and artificial. Natural food colourings are obtained from natural sources such as extracts from
  plants like flowers and roots. For example, orange food colouring can be derived from saffron
  tendrils. Natural food colouring can also be obtained from an insect (Cochineal) by crushing them
  to release carminic acid which has a red colour.
* ##### Sausage
  
  The addition of additives in the production of sausages improves preservation and modifies the
  sensory characteristics of the sausage. Most Additives used in sausage & jerky making are not
  spices and do not do necessarily "Season The Meat". They usually perform a function such as
  retaining color or moisture. They can also protect meat from bacteria while smoking or drying.
  However, some additives such as cures do affect taste and color to a degree. Always follow the
  directions provided and do not add more than directed.

## WIDE RANGE OF APPLICATIONS
* Beverages
* Dairy products

* ##### Beverages
  
  A wide range of ingredients are required in their formulation of beverages.Additives like sugar or
  sweeteners which are added in higher amounts whereas additives like preservatives are added in
  small quantity. Hence additives may be grouped as Major and Minor additives.
* ##### Dairy products
  
  Dairy system is a complex colloidal dispersion system, the dispersion medium is water, and the
  dispersions are lactose, inorganic salts, protein, fat, gas, etc. It is an unstable system. Dairy
  products are both highly nutritious and highly unstable substances that are prone to spoilage.
  emulsifier in dairy milk and preservatives used in milk are important for dairy processing.
  Nutritional fortification, stabilization of the milk system, and extension of shelf life. When
  adding natural vegetable fiber ingredients and transglutaminase for sale to milk with wheat,
  cereals, eggs and other substances, add emulsification stabilizers to delay the floating of milk
  fat and protein precipitation to achieve a balance of emulsion, so that the product does not
  stratify and change the structure, and extend the shelf life.
* ##### Baking
  
  Food attives is widely used in baking.They were added to flour products for a variety of purposes,
  including bleaching the flour, ageing, slowing the rate of staling, and improving the texture of
  the finished product,Kemfood shall provide the best sulotion for you.
* ##### Cookies
  
  The ingredients used in preparation of cookies affect size, color, and sensory qualities.
  Additional ingredients are also added for flavor and texture. There are two main types of cookies,
  soft and hard cookies. Soft cookies contain more liquids to produce the necessary structure i.e.,
  moistness and softness. THE MAIN INGREDIENTS present in nearly every type of cookie are wheat
  flour, sweeteners ,fat,sodium bicarbonate and ammonium bicarbonate.
* ##### Jelly
  
  The application of food ingredients especially food thickeners is a key technology in jelly
  production. Substances essential for fruit jelly making are fruit flavor, pectin, sugar, acid and
  water. A pectin gel or jelly forms when a suitable concentration of pectin, sugar, acid, and water
  is achieved.
* ##### Candy
  
  Food additives are substances added to food to preserve flavour or enhance its taste and
  appearance. There are many types of food additives in candy which serve different purposes such as
  emulsifiers, stabilizers, thickeners, anti­caking agents, preservatives, antioxidants, leavening
  agents, acidulants, and natural or artificial colours and flavours.
  A main component of candies is food colouring. There are two types of food colourings – natural
  and artificial. Natural food colourings are obtained from natural sources such as extracts from
  plants like flowers and roots. For example, orange food colouring can be derived from saffron
  tendrils. Natural food colouring can also be obtained from an insect (Cochineal) by crushing them
  to release carminic acid which has a red colour.
* ##### Sausage
  
  The addition of additives in the production of sausages improves preservation and modifies the
  sensory characteristics of the sausage. Most Additives used in sausage & jerky making are not
  spices and do not do necessarily "Season The Meat". They usually perform a function such as
  retaining color or moisture. They can also protect meat from bacteria while smoking or drying.
  However, some additives such as cures do affect taste and color to a degree. Always follow the
  directions provided and do not add more than directed.

Why Choose Maple Biotech

## India's Premier Pharmaceutical Excipients Manufacturer

For over four decades, Maple Biotech has been the trusted source for pharmaceutical excipients, food
ingredients, and specialty materials — combining rigorous quality, deep technical expertise, and
reliable global supply.

### Full-Range Excipient Portfolio

Our pharmaceutical excipient portfolio spans all major functional categories: diluents and binders
(Microcrystalline Cellulose grades MCC PH-101 through PH-200, Pregelatinized Starch), disintegrants
(Sodium Starch Glycolate, Croscarmellose Sodium, Crospovidone Type A and B), flow aids (Colloidal
Silicon Dioxide, Magnesium Stearate, Calcium Stearate), and polymers (Povidone PVP K30 and K90,
Sodium CMC). All products comply with USP/NF, EP, IP, and JP monographs.

### Regulatory-Ready Documentation

Every pharmaceutical excipient from Maple Biotech is supported by comprehensive regulatory
documentation: US Drug Master Files (US-DMF), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Material Safety Data
Sheets (MSDS/SDS), BSE/TSE declarations, and Allergen statements. Our WHO-GMP certificate and US-DMF
enable customers to register drug products in FDA-regulated (USA), EMA-regulated (EU),
PMDA-regulated (Japan), and ICH-harmonised markets worldwide.

### Direct Compression & Co-processed Excipients

Maple Biotech specialises in direct compression pharmaceutical excipients that eliminate costly
granulation steps. Our co-processed range — AMBI-CELACT (MCC + Lactose Monohydrate 75:25), AMBI-GG
(MCC + Guar Gum for sustained release), and AMBI-TCP (MCC + Tricalcium Phosphate for calcium
supplement tablets) — delivers superior flowability and compressibility versus single-component
materials, reducing tablet manufacturing time and cost.

## India's Premier Pharmaceutical Excipients Manufacturer

For over four decades, Maple Biotech has been the trusted source for pharmaceutical excipients, food
ingredients, and specialty materials — combining rigorous quality, deep technical expertise, and
reliable global supply.

### Full-Range Excipient Portfolio

Our pharmaceutical excipient portfolio spans all major functional categories: diluents and binders
(Microcrystalline Cellulose grades MCC PH-101 through PH-200, Pregelatinized Starch), disintegrants
(Sodium Starch Glycolate, Croscarmellose Sodium, Crospovidone Type A and B), flow aids (Colloidal
Silicon Dioxide, Magnesium Stearate, Calcium Stearate), and polymers (Povidone PVP K30 and K90,
Sodium CMC). All products comply with USP/NF, EP, IP, and JP monographs.

### Regulatory-Ready Documentation

Every pharmaceutical excipient from Maple Biotech is supported by comprehensive regulatory
documentation: US Drug Master Files (US-DMF), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Material Safety Data
Sheets (MSDS/SDS), BSE/TSE declarations, and Allergen statements. Our WHO-GMP certificate and US-DMF
enable customers to register drug products in FDA-regulated (USA), EMA-regulated (EU),
PMDA-regulated (Japan), and ICH-harmonised markets worldwide.

### Direct Compression & Co-processed Excipients

Maple Biotech specialises in direct compression pharmaceutical excipients that eliminate costly
granulation steps. Our co-processed range — AMBI-CELACT (MCC + Lactose Monohydrate 75:25), AMBI-GG
(MCC + Guar Gum for sustained release), and AMBI-TCP (MCC + Tricalcium Phosphate for calcium
supplement tablets) — delivers superior flowability and compressibility versus single-component
materials, reducing tablet manufacturing time and cost.

### Reliable Global Export Supply

With established logistics to 50+ countries including the USA, Germany, UK, France, UAE, Saudi
Arabia, Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia, Kenya, and South Africa, Maple Biotech delivers pharmaceutical
excipients by FCL containers, LCL, and air freight. Our Pune MIDC Bhosari facility maintains bonded
warehouse stock for rapid dispatch, with Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary, and fumigation
certificates provided as standard for all export shipments.

**About Us**

Maple Biotech Pvt. Ltd., established in 1982, has a towering presence in the international market.
We are a leading manufacturer, exporter and supplier of high quality chemicals and pharmaceutical
excipients. Our range of products includes micro crystalline cellulose, alpha cellulose, sodium
starch glycolate, croscarmellose sodium and carmellose calcium, developed through own R&D. Our Alpha
Cellulose is acclaimed worldwide in the chloro-alkali industry for its high quality. We started
operation with the manufacture of cellulose powder for the welding electrode industry and later on
expanded our product line. The company is promoted by Mr. Nandan M. Bhandari, who obtained his
Masters Degree in Chemical Engineering from University of Saskatchewan, Canada and did extensive
research at N.C. State University at Raleigh, United States of America.

Maple Biotech is led by highly dedicated and devoted professionals with years of experience on the
chemical industries. We pay meticulous attention to every detail from the initial stage of
production to the final stage. Every product is subjected to stringent quality checks, to ensure
that no flawless products are manufactured.

**Our Products**

Maple Biotech Pvt. Ltd. is a distinguished manufacturer, exporter and supplier of chemicals and
pharmaceutical excipients. Our range of products includes:

* Micro crystalline cellulose
* Alpha cellulose
* Sodium starch glycolate
* Croscarmellose sodium
* Carmellose calcium, etc.

**Infrastructure**

At, Maple Biotech Pvt. Ltd., we are equipped with state of the art infrastructure to ensure flawless
production, storage and distribution of our products. Our team comprises of highly qualified
personnel and skilled workers. The R&D efforts at our unit are directed not only towards development
of innovative products but also towards making them available at economical prices.

**Quality**

We have set up the most modern plant with a state of the art laboratory for quality assurance as
well as microbial testing. Our R&D unit set up at Bhosari plant in Pune enables us to manufacture
world class products. Stringent checks are followed throughout the manufacturing process to
guarantee defect-free products.

**Clients**

Our premium quality products and prompt customer service have fetched us a wide clientele in home
and abroad. We are a major exporter of chemicals and pharmaceutical excipients to Latin America, US,
Middle East and Far East.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

#### We are excited to announce our partnership with Helaina on effera™ - the first human equivalent
#### lactoferrin available on the market, supported by pre-clinical and clinical studies.

Lactoferrin is the most abundant protein found in human colostrum, lactoferrin sequesters and

health, and active nutrition formulations, offering superior bioavailability and unique benefits in
each category.

 

# What We Do

Mitsubishi International Food Ingredients, Inc. has solid and reliable connections with domestic and
global ingredient supplier partners to help CPG companies, from corporations to small mom and pop
shops, customize formulas to match or create value-added finished product goods.

Our commitment to excellence reflects our approach to creating value for our customers and
delivering unparalleled products and services. We focus on the unique needs of every customer,
refining our products and services to elevate your business. Among our many product offerings, our
customized seasoning blends exemplify our strengths in formulation and applications. Through
partnerships with R&D, we strive to deliver consistency in seasoning notes and flavor profiles for a
wide range of applications, including meat, snack seasonings, sauces, dressings, side dishes,
functional blends, and bakery mixes. This is just one example of how we remain committed to
providing innovative product solutions for every customer, every time,

## Vision + Mission

**Vision: Source global ingredients, locally**
To be a significant and unique supplier of a broad range of globally sourced quality ingredients to
the food, nutraceutical and other selected markets in the United States, Canada, and other
countries.

**Mission 1: Be an Innovative Leader**
To anticipate market demands and offer innovative, quality, safe, healthy, value-added ingredients
to satisfy consumer demands.

**Mission 2: Deliver Beyond Expectations**
To continuously provide extra value to our customers, suppliers, employees, shareholders, and
society.

**Mission 3: Operate to Meet the Highest Standards**
To conduct business fully complying with legal plus industrial requirements at the highest level of
ethical behavior in a socially responsible and environmentally friendly fashion.

## Quality Sourcing

distribute 1,000+ food, nutritional, and pharmaceutical products to customers nationwide. All of
MIFI’s GMP warehouses are food-grade and FDA-registered. All partnered LTL and TL trucks, equipment,
and processes adhere to all federal and state requirements. Carriers have damage prevention programs
in place to maintain product integrity and ensure compliant delivery. Our warehouses are prepared
and well-stocked, over 90 percent of our customers receive next-day service.

## Dedicated Customer Service

**ACCESSIBILITY**

Our customers have always been our first priority. We consider customer relationships our greatest
asset. Your calls are not transferred to a third-party call center or an automated phone system. You
will never have a long wait queue to speak to a real human who is empowered to help you. We
guarantee you will always receive one-on-one, dedicated, and committed customer service. The best in
B2B customer care begins here.

We proactively stay connected with customers throughout every step of the order fulfillment process
and we often check in to confirm forecasts and upcoming production schedules. We remain connected so
we can stay with you every step of the way to meet your needs as quickly and efficiently as
possible.

 

**FLEXIBILITY**

Our dedicated team of customer service representatives and product coordinators will explore every
available option to make sure your products are shipped on time and meet your go-to-market
timeframe.

## About Niran Bio Tech

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global supplier network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of acidulants and functional ingredients, supporting
consistent quality, flavor balance, and performance across diverse food and beverage applications,
including beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy, and nutrition products.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

## About NovaSol Ingredients

Eureka! That's the emotion we have when we discover perfection. Great men have done it, and have
changed the course of human history. In today's modern world of commodification, what is perfection
then? It's not something that happens by luck, it happens by trial and error- and when it comes to
food, the margin of error is negligible. Food is nourishment, the clock that keeps us ticking, yet
food is universal. How do you achieve perfection in food? That was the same question a father and
son duo had in 1985. Thirty years later, they are known globally for revolutionising food
ingredients manufacturing, and their Eureka momentinnovation. More precisely, innovation through
technology.

## About NovaSol Ingredients

Eureka! That's the emotion we have when we discover perfection. Great men have done it, and have
changed the course of human history. In today's modern world of commodification, what is perfection
then? It's not something that happens by luck, it happens by trial and error- and when it comes to
food, the margin of error is negligible. Food is nourishment, the clock that keeps us ticking, yet
food is universal. How do you achieve perfection in food? That was the same question a father and
son duo had in 1985. Thirty years later, they are known globally for revolutionising food
ingredients manufacturing, and their Eureka momentinnovation. More precisely, innovation through
technology.

good for your digestive system.

FOOD, POLYMER & PERSONAL CARE SOLUTIONS

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

Driving ESG together

Responsibility and ESG are deeply ingrained in Palsgaard’s heritage. We help customers reduce food
waste, optimise raw material use, and extend shelf life, while also aiming to lower carbon emissions
and improve production practices. Within our own operations, we invest in renewable energy,
responsible sourcing, and resource efficiency, continually setting ambitious targets to benefit
people, planet, and society. Our RSPO SG-certified emulsifiers and alternatives can help you meet
your ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Collaborative partnerships

We believe business is personal. By working closely with our customers, we gain a deep understanding
of your goals and challenges, co-creating solutions that make a real difference. Whether you’re
launching a new product, refining a process, or tackling production issues, our experts are with you
every step of the way. With Palsgaard, you gain more than an ingredient supplier – you gain a
committed partner focused on your success.

# EU SPECIALTY FOOD INGREDIENTS

Specialty food ingredients have technological and/or functional benefits and are essential in
providing today’s consumer with a wide range of tasty, safe, healthy, affordable, qualitative and
sustainably produced food. They are key segment in the European food industry that is used in many
of consumer foods and have consequently become part of our daily life.

EU Specialty Food Ingredients is THE voice of specialty food ingredients in Europe. EU Specialty
Food Ingredients represents its members by:

– Engaging with authorities for the continued development of a fair regulatory environment;

– Being a transparent and credible partner, committed to science and knowledge sharing;

– Developing understanding of the role and benefits that specialty food ingredients play today and
tomorrow, starting with food manufacturers.

And thus: increasing trust in specialty food ingredients towards the relevant stakeholders.

# Latest Updates from EU Specialty Food Ingredients
* ## [ 02-07 EFSA FAF Panel ][37]
  
  -
  
  A delegate from **EU Specialty Food Ingredients** is following the Open session of EFSA's FAF
  Panel in Parma. Focus is primarily on the re-evaluation of sweeteners and Talc (E553b). Updates on
  the evaluation of new food additives of the FAF work programme for the 2026-2027 period should
  also be provided.
* ## [ 01-07 European Food Forum ][38]
  
  -
  
  EU Specialty Food Ingredients participation in the [European Food Forum][39] (EFF) Annual General
  Assembly 2026 highlights the growing importance of structured, evidence-based dialogue between
  policymakers, academia, and the food supply chain to support a competitive, resilient and
  sustainable European food system.
* ## [ 12-05 DG SANTE Advisory Group ][40]
  
  -
  
  A representative of EU Specialty Food Ingredients attends the plenary meeting of the Advisory
  Group on the Sustainability of Food Systems in Brussels. This will be the opportunity for our
  federation to receive an update on iter alia the Food & Feed Safety Simplification Package or the
  implementation of the Safe Hearts Plan. 
* ## [ 29-04 Stakeholder Workshop on Biotech Act 2 ][41]
  
  -
  
  **EU Specialty Food Ingredients** attends the [Stakeholder Workshop on Biotech Act II][42]
  organised by DG GROW to collect stakeholder input on the design of Biotech Act II, with a focus on
  industrial biotechnology and biomanufacturing and on removing Single Market barriers that hinder
  scale‑up, investment and deployment in the EU.
* [ More Updates » ][43]

# EU SPECIALTY FOOD INGREDIENTS

Specialty food ingredients have technological and/or functional benefits and are essential in
providing today’s consumer with a wide range of tasty, safe, healthy, affordable, qualitative and
sustainably produced food. They are key segment in the European food industry that is used in many
of consumer foods and have consequently become part of our daily life.

EU Specialty Food Ingredients is THE voice of specialty food ingredients in Europe. EU Specialty
Food Ingredients represents its members by:

– Engaging with authorities for the continued development of a fair regulatory environment;

– Being a transparent and credible partner, committed to science and knowledge sharing;

– Developing understanding of the role and benefits that specialty food ingredients play today and
tomorrow, starting with food manufacturers.

And thus: increasing trust in specialty food ingredients towards the relevant stakeholders.

# Wholesale Food Ingredients Supplier

Established in 2001 with the ethos of “Tender Loving Care,” TLC Ingredients has been committed to
providing exceptional service, as a food ingredients distributor, to our clients. Founded by Tommy
Turriff, Peter Lorusso, and Jim Cavelle, our mission from the start has been to deliver unparalleled
customer service and attention to detail.

[A white letter l is sitting on top of a green background.]
[Using a tablet for a wholesale food ingredients supplier]

## Our Core Values

Located near Chicago in our state-of-the-art facility built in 2009, we pride ourselves on our
technical expertise and unwavering sense of urgency. Renowned as a premier distribution company, we
specialize in food ingredients, industrial chemicals, and phenolic resins. At TLC Ingredients, our
core values include a steadfast commitment to food safety and Responsible Distribution.

## Food Products

Our extensive range of ingredients and chemicals caters to the global food, feed, and wellness
industries, reflecting our dedication to quality and diversity.

## Pet Food Products

TLC Ingredients has partnered with the top ingredient manufacturers to help customers formulate
nutritional and feed products that meet consumer demands.

## Durez Phenolic Resins

As a proud part of the Sumitomo Bakelite phenolic resin portfolio, Durez stands as a leader in
thermoset resins utilized in adhesives, specialty coatings, abrasives, rubber, and friction
industries.

## Industrial Products

Representing manufacturers across various sectors, including personal care, household, industrial
and institutional, water treatment, adhesives, and specialty chemical manufacturing, we offer a
comprehensive selection of industrial chemicals to meet diverse needs.

[A building with the words tlc ingredients on it.]

## Experience the Difference

For more information about TLC Ingredients or to experience our superior customer service and
premium chemicals and ingredients firsthand, please do not hesitate to contact us.

## Trice Chemicals IND LLC

Trice Chemicals Industrial LLC is a company Established in 2002 based in the United Arab Emirates

chemical products.

chemicals, disinfectants, detergents, degreasers, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Their products

Industry Focus: We offer a wide range of chemical solutions for various industries, including
Healthcare, Automotive, Paint, Fiberglass, Construction, Printing, Oil and Gas, Food and Beverages,

and Fishery Farms, Packaging and industrial sectors. We understand the specific needs and challenges
of each industry and provide tailored chemical solutions accordingly.

We strive to maintain high manufacturing standards and comply with industry regulations and
certifications. This ensures that our customers receive reliable and effective chemical products.

Customization and Private Labelling: We offer customization options and private labelling services
for our clients. This allows businesses to have their own branding on chemical products, providing a
personalized touch to their cleaning and maintenance solutions.

Distribution and Support: We have a distribution network that extends beyond the UAE. They supply
our products to customers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Europe region. We also
provide technical support and guidance to our clients, ensuring they make the most of their chemical

### Find the Materials You Need

The UL Prospector materials database helps you find plastics, chemicals and ingredients for your
next formulation and product development challenge. Product formulators, engineers, and developers
can locate technical data on hundreds of thousands of products in one easy-to-use search engine.

Create your free account to:
* Find materials, technical information and suppliers quickly and easily
* Search by material type, supplier, application, or functionality
* Stay informed with industry trends and information

Beyond materials search, Prospector also has starter formulations to accelerate your product
development. You can request samples from multiple suppliers within your Prospector account for
simple order organization. All product listings include the supplying company’s contact information
for quick communication.

Access is free to qualified professionals. Simply complete the registration form to start finding
materials.

[Create Your Free Account Now][37] [ Learn more][38]

* #### Retailer and Regulatory Compliance Highlights
  
  Analyze ingredient-level compliance information within Prospector for more than 200 global
  regulatory and advisory lists and 30 international retailer lists.

  Utilize side-by-side comparisons, UL Yellow Card performance information, OEM/automotive approved
  materials, find alternative resins and more advanced search techniques.
* #### Visual data representation
  
  View curve multipoint data for performance characteristics, compare properties on a radar plot or
  explore material features plotted graphically.

# World-Class Color Solutions

Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Ltd is a leading manufacturer of Superior Synthetic Colours
suitable for Food, Pharmaceutical, Cosmetic, Personal Care & Home Care industries. Our colours are
presently being distributed and consumed in over 80 countries across 6 continents. We have 2
manufacturing facilities located in the state of Maharashtra & 1 manufacturing facility in the state
of Gujarat. Today VSFIL is an ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 17025, HACCP, FSSC 22000 (GFSI) & GMP
certified company. Our Manufacturing facilities have been audited and found satisfactory by the U.S.
FDA. All our Food Grade colours carry HALAL and Kosher certification.
